# SMAA lookup textures

`AreaTex.h` and `SearchTex.h` are the precomputed area and search textures of
SMAA, from https://github.com/iryoku/smaa (`Textures/`), MIT licensed
(`LICENSE.txt`). The shader itself is `code/renderergl2/glsl/smaa_lib.glsl`.
Used by the GL2 renderer's SMAA pass (`code/renderergl2/tr_smaa.c`, `r_smaa`).
